title: Mossy Orchid Mantis
description: A highly detailed orchid mantis with a green, purple, and brown mottled exoskeleton stands on a decaying log covered in moss and colorful lichens. Its elongated body, curled antennae, and delicate wings with visible damage are captured in sharp focus against a natural forest floor background.
prompt: A photorealistic close-up of an orchid mantis standing on a moss-covered decaying log in a forest. The insect has a translucent green body with purple abdominal segments and brown mottling, delicate damaged wings, curled antennae, and long slender legs. The log is covered in vibrant yellow, pink, and green lichens with water droplets visible. Natural lighting, extremely detailed textures, macro photography style.
